svg.title: All 72 targeted pack-once cases compared with NumPy
svg.desc: A mobile heatmap of NumPy time divided by solvcon time for two dtypes, three broadcast positions, two unsupported inner layouts, and six affected matrix sizes. Every ratio is above one.
svg.text: cell = NumPy time / solvcon time; above 1.00 wins
Every displayed value is recomputed from the public JSONL.
